{{Quote|This girl&mdash;Aayla&mdash;she called me through the Force. She helped calm me in battle with the wampa. Could she be&hellip;''"<br />"''A Jedi? Perhaps.|Quinlan Vos and Tholme|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 42" />}}
'''Aayla Secura''', born '''Aaylas'ecura''', was a female [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] in the twilight years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], who served with distinction as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She served as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] under the tutelage of [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], and later, Vos' own master [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]]. Both Secura and Vos survived a brush with the dark side early in their [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]], though she later proved herself worthy of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|knighthood]].

After Secura was promoted to the level of Jedi Knight, the Clone Wars broke out, and she was one of many Jedi to participate in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] (22 BBY) such marked the beginning of the conflict. With the outbreak of hostilities against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Jedi were pressed into service as officers within the newly-formed [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], largely comprising several millions of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] such were genetic copies of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]; Secura as a Knight was made a general and received command of the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]], [[Bly/Legends|Marshal Commander Bly]] (CC-5052) serving as her second-in-command. She served in various campaigns, surviving such infamous battles as those on [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]] and [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Indeed, such were her achievements that Secura was promoted to the level of Jedi Master near the beginning of the conflict.

As a Jedi Master, Aayla Secura led the Republic war efforts at [[Quell/Legends|Quell]] and was instrumental in the [[First Battle of Kamino|defense]] of Kamino and later [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. However, despite her undoubted prowess, Secura met her end during the instigation of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]<nowiki/> in 19 BBY, shot and killed by her clone troopers within the 327th. Master Secura was remembered for generations by the people of the worlds she had helped during her life, and stories of her were known to have become part of the culture of many such people.

==Biography==
===Early life===
Born around [[48 BBY/Legends|48 BBY]],<ref name="JCF" /> Aayla Secura, or Aaylas'ecura in her [[Twi'leki/Legends|native tongue]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|134|Secura, Aayla}}</ref> was a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-skinned, [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], and a member of the influential [[Clan Secura]] on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="DB" />

[[File:Young_Aayla_and_Padawan_Quinlan.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A young Secura and her savior]]
In [[46 BBY/Legends|46 BBY]], a two-year-old Secura<ref name="JCF" /> was discovered on Ryloth to be strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] during a mission undertaken by the young [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], the [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]]. Though she was clan member [[Lon Secura]]'s niece, the young Secura was sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] to a [[Unidentified Hutt crime lord (Aayla Secura's master)|Hutt crime lord]] after the death of her father. During Tholme and Vos's visit, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] newly-acquired guard [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] freed itself went on a rampage, and Secura found herself in immediate peril. Fortunately, she emanated her need through the Force and was [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] and saved by Quinlan Vos. A strong connection was formed between them, and Vos persuaded Master Tholme to test Secura to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Secura joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]],<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 42" /> underwent [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of training with Master Tholme,<ref name="CSWE" /> and, when she was about ten years old,<ref name="JCF2">{{JCFCite|url=posts/13327474|board=Literature|thread=The Official Jan Duursema Discussion Thread|user=Jan_Duursema|date=2003-09-25|time=10:08 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180625181621/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-jan-duursema-discussion-thread.5915607/page-36|quote=Aayla was 2 when Quin and Tholme found her on Ryloth. Quin was 11. So there's 9 years difference in age. Quin is Obi-Wan's age--which I think was stated as 25 during Ep I. So Aayla would be 16 at the time of Ep I.}} {{C|Note: In response to a question directed to Jan Duursema by [[Billy Buehler]] (aka The2ndQuest) on the [[Jedi Council Forums]], Jan Duursema explained that Aayla "would have been about 10" & "Quin about 19" during the flashback sequence in ''[[Jedi: Aayla Secura]]'' depicting Quinlan Vos taking Aayla as his Padawan.}}</ref> Quinlan Vos took her as his Padawan.<ref name="Aayla Secura">''[[Jedi: Aayla Secura]]''</ref>

To celebrate the occasion of her thirteenth birthday, Vos gave Secura the gift of a [[Heart of Fire]], a glowing stone from his homeworld<ref name="Heart of Fire">{{StoryCite|story=Heart of Fire (comic story)|book=Dark Horse Extra|bformatted=''Dark Horse Extra'' 35&ndash;37}}</ref> of [[Kiffu/Legends|Kiffu]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> which she later passed on to a fellow Twi'lek Padawan named [[Xiaan Amersu]], with whom Secura felt kinship.<ref name="Heart of Fire" /> Secura once learned a very valuable lesson when her dear pet [[T'da]] [[Death/Legends|died]]. Her master comforted her by relating how her beloved was now part of the Force, and would also live on in her heart. Ironically enough, she buried T'da on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]<ref name="The Hidden Enemy 3">[[Republic 83|''Republic'' 83]]</ref>&mdash;a planet she returned to just before her own life abruptly ended.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />

Padawan Secura and her Master, Quinlan Vos, undertook many successive missions together. They solved the [[Lodi|Mystery of the Lodi]] on [[Solibus IV]], [[Mission to Xoman III|rescued]] a [[Unidentified princess|young princess]] from [[skyboat]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on [[Xoman III]],<ref name="Heart of Fire" /> and faced the [[terbeast]]s of [[Ogden Minor]]. Additionally, Vos shared with the Secura the story of the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the pirate [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark]] in which he had taken part as a Padawan.<ref name="SW36">[[Star Wars (1998) 36|''Star Wars'' (1998) 36]]</ref> Secura and Vos conducted undercover operations on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] while Jedi Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] was stranded there<ref name="SW38">[[Star Wars (1998) 38|''Star Wars'' (1998) 38]]</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" />

Later, Vos and Secura were assigned on a mission to Ryloth to investigate the source of the drug [[glitteryll]]. To hide their own involvement, Secura's uncle, [[Pol Secura]], and Vos's clanmate, [[Asanté Vos]], captured and drugged the two Jedi with the substance, inducing amnesia. While Vos was abandoned on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]],<ref name="SW21">[[Star Wars (1998) 21|''Star Wars'' (1998) 21]]</ref> Secura was kept on Ryloth by her uncle, who had to feed her more glitteryll each day to keep her memories from returning. She forgot that she was a Jedi; she forgot she had a master and that she harbored [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]].<ref name="SW22" />

Quinlan Vos, searching for his Padawan, came to Pol Secura's quarters. He showed his Padawan her [[Aayla Secura's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] but failed to restore her memory. Vos had discovered that Pol Secura was behind the drugging, and when the Twi'lek initially refused to reveal the identity of [[Chom Frey Kaa]], his patron in the glitteryll scheme, the Jedi used the Force to strangle Secura with his own [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] head-tail and electrocute him with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. Trying to rescue her uncle, the amnesiac Secura lashed out with the Force, accidentally [[Telekinesis|Force pushing]] him off a balcony to his death. Secura fled,<ref name="SW22" /> blaming the unfamiliar Quinlan Vos for the death of her uncle.<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 32">[[Star Wars (1998) 32|''Star Wars'' (1998) 32]]</ref>

====Brush with the dark side====
{{Quote|From the moment you stepped foot on this planet, I sensed you&hellip;your scattered thoughts&hellip;I sent out my thoughts&hellip;my will&hellip;I drew you to me&hellip;for I need you, little Jedi. Great need&hellip;|Volfe Karkko to Aayla Secura|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 32" />}}
[[File:AaylaKaarko-SWREP34.png|thumb|180px|Secura is seduced to the dark side of the Force by Volfe Karkko.]]
Desiring revenge on Quinlan Vos, Secura hid herself on a pirate [[Starship/Legends|ship]] en route to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]], twin planet of Kiffu. There, she discovered and released [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Volfe Karkko]] from his [[Stasis field/Legends|stasis field]]. She gave in to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and was willing to help the [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] Dark Jedi.<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 32" /> He gave her command of his Anzati minions and had her hunt down the Jedi he had lured to Kiffex&mdash;Vos, Tholme, and the itinerant Master [[Zao]]. Karkko needed them alive to regain his strength; he needed to suck their "[[Soup (Anzati)|Jedi-soup]]." But first he needed to feed himself and his Anzati. Secura took the Anzati and stormed a local stronghold. There she faced off against the Jedi and got away with their captured people.<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 34">[[Star Wars (1998) 34|''Star Wars'' (1998) 34]]</ref> Vos followed her and reached the prison of Karkko. Again, she fought against her former master, but then she at last realized her true identity. At that moment Karkko used Force lightning to knock her out. When she woke up, she found Karkko dead.<ref name="SW35" />

Leaving Kiffex for Kiffu, the Jedi met with a delegation from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]&mdash;Masters [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]&mdash;who reassigned Secura from Vos, in light of the the darkness that touched them both, to complete her training as Tholme's Padawan. While she, Tholme, and the councilors made their return to Coruscant, Vos, on the other hand, pictured himself as "a leaf blown forth by the wind," and he left Kiffex, going where the Force told him to go.<ref name="SW35" />

===Return to Coruscant===
{{Quote|Patience, Aayla. A Jedi you still are, and with you is the strength to overcome. But ''believe'' it, you must.|Yoda to Secura after the latter returns from Kiffex|<ref name="Shon-Ju">''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''</ref>}}
En route aboard the councilors' starship [[Intrepid (luxury cruiser)|''Intrepid'']], Plo Koon used his [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic powers]] guide Secura as she arranged and organized in her mind her newly recovered memories, allowing her to remember her past adventures with Quinlan Vos. Secura was struck by the scarred face of ''Intrepid'' crewmember [[Jace Dallin]], a remnant of the Stark Hyperspace War. By way of explanation, Dallin, Tholme, and the councilors&mdash;all Stark veterans&mdash;shared their reminiscences of the conflict, replacing Secura's lost memories of Vos' account.<ref name="SW36" />

After Secura returned to Coruscant, she sought the counsel of Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. He told her that he was relieved when she had been found. She herself feared she was still lost after what had happened to her. Master Tholme had briefed Yoda on all that had happened to Aayla, and Yoda counseled her that she should not judge herself harshly. She replied that something was missing from her life now. Yoda offered his advice, telling her she was a Jedi and to be patient. Finally, he wished for her to understand that the Force leads them towards not what they always want, but what they need. Still somewhat confused, Yoda gave her one last piece of advice&mdash;to believe the Force was with her and would help her.<ref name="Shon-Ju" />

====Ascension to Knighthood====
[[FIle:Aayla Secura Quinlan Vos NEC.jpg|thumb|Jedi Knight Aayla Secura and Jedi Master Quinlan Vos]]
As Tholme's Padawan, Secura went undercover, infiltrating the Twi'lek [[clan Fenn]]. She discovered that the clan's leader, Ro Fenn, was planning an attack on the Secura clan's male heir, the child [[Nat Secura]]. She informed Tholme and quickly joined her master against this new threat. Facing off against two [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Morgukai]], Tholme was defeated but still managed to slip on their ship. Unfortunately, he was discovered and imprisoned. Secura followed [[Vilmarh Grahrk]], who was in league with the Nikto, to his ship [[Inferno (Vilmarh Grahrk)|''Inferno'']], but the Devaronian escaped.<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 42" />

The Force led Secura to a junkyard on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. There she found her former master, Vos, and helped him fight against bounty hunters. She explained all that had happened to Quinlan, and the two decided to rescue Nat Secura and Master Tholme. They succeeded in tracking down Grahrk and persuaded him to tell them where the two Morgukai went; the Nikto had left Ord Mantell for [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]], the home planet of the Nikto and site of the fortress of the Twi'lek [[Kh'aris Fenn]], who, all the while, had been behind the clan's current strife and misery.<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 43">[[Star Wars (1998) 43|''Star Wars'' (1998) 43]]</ref>

[[File:Aayla_and_Quin_Ord_Mantell.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Vos and Secura on Ord Mantell]]
They quickly set course for Kintan and there faced off against the two Morgukai, [[Bok]] and his father, [[Tsyr]], who had waited for the Jedi to arrive.<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 43" /> Escaping their pursuers at a river of lava, the two Jedi broke into the fortress only to be confronted by the Nikto again:<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 44">[[Star Wars (1998) 44|''Star Wars'' (1998) 44]]</ref> Secura was to rescue Nat Secura and Tholme, Vos would fight the Nikto.<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 45">[[Star Wars (1998) 45|''Star Wars'' (1998) 45]]</ref>

Secura reached the dungeon, defeated the [[Torture/Legends|torture]] droid [[AX/RX]], freed Tholme and Nat, and went to Vos's aid. Vos had already beheaded Tsyr, but he had been knocked to the ground by Bok. Secura saved Vos's life by engaging Bok before he could deliver the final blow. She wounded the Nikto, taking his right hand, but did not kill him. Bok let himself fall hundreds of meters in order to keep his honor. The three Jedi and Nat survived. They returned the young Twi'lek boy to his father, but, unfortunately, Fenn escaped from Ryloth to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] hidden stronghold. Ro Fenn, now forced to face Twi'lek justice, was sent into a land of no return&mdash;the [[Bright Lands]], the side of Ryloth that was baked in eternal sunlight. Back on Coruscant, Secura and Vos were both promoted by the Jedi High Council. Secura was granted the rank of Jedi Knight, and Vos, that of a Jedi Master.<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 45" /> In [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]], shortly before the promotion, Tholme made a record of Vos' recent history which cited his rescue of Secura among his accomplishments.<ref name="JVS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

Secura visited the [[Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array|Kuat Drive Yards]] as a representative of the Jedi Order for the inspection and unveiling of the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|corporation's]] [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]]. Finding the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] testing performance satisfactory, Secura and Adi Gallia performed a ceremonial [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] salute in the [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati's]] honor, recorded and reported on by the "[[Jedi Watch]]" segment of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] Vol. 531 #47, published on 13:3:14 [[Great ReSynchronization|GrS]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|jediwatch/13314_1.html|New Jedi Starfighter Unveiled}}</ref>

===Clone Wars (22 BBY&ndash;19 BBY)===
[[File:Aayla_TCW.png|thumb|right|180px|Aayla Secura during the Clone Wars]]
{{Quote|Aayla Secura made a point of seeing us off personally; calling us the bravest soldiers she had ever met. It's a good thing we were wearing helmets, because none of us could bear to look her in the eye.|Diary of the 501st, before Order 66|<ref name="battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
====Battle of Geonosis====
Aayla Secura was in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] at the time of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], and thus was a member of<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> the 200-strong<ref name="UVG">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Jedi task force]] sent to the planet to rescue Jedi Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], his Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], who were held captive there and scheduled for public execution in the [[Petranaki arena]].<ref name="Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>

Taking an active role in the fighting, Secura was one of approximately thirty survivors of the ensuing skirmish between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' forces and the Jedi strike team. During the fighting she dispatched a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droid]] with a kick to the face while fellow Jedi Knight [[Sarrissa Jeng/Legends|Sarrissa Jeng]] dealt with a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] warrior nearby. As the fight turned in the Separatists' favor, Secura was forced at gunpoint, along with her fellow survivors, into a circle in the center of the arena. Secura and the others narrowly escaped certain death due to the timely arrival of Grand Master Yoda, leading the newly commissioned [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Secura and the survivors were evacuated on several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|gunships]] and she went on to lead her own squad of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] into the developing ground battle.
This battle marked the outbreak of the wider conflict that would come to be known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Attack of the Clones" />

Secura struck up a lasting friendship with Jedi Master [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] and gave him the gift of a custom [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], accompanied by the teasing remark that he would not need it were he her equal as a Jedi.<ref name="One Minute to Midnight">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20060302OneMinute|text=Living Force: One Minute to Midnight|int=Living Force: One Minute to Midnight}}</ref> During the Clone Wars, she traveled to [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] to visit him and his companion [[Trilinae Untaire]]. Though Secura expressed concern that Jeht's preoccupation with his large collection of personal starships was in violation of the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code's]] opposition to personal possessions, she eagerly took part in repairing his antique starship the [[Legacy (Darrus Jeht)|''Legacy'']] upon learning that he had acquired backstage tickets for a concert by [[Sien'Soro]], a band enjoyed by both Secura and Untaire.<ref name="Priorities">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041028|text=Priorities}}</ref>

====Mission to Corellia====
Like almost every other fully trained Jedi in the Order, Secura became a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]]. Eight standard days after the Battle of Geonosis, she was sent on a [[Mission to Corellia (Clone Wars)|mission]] to intercept [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ratri Tane]], who had fled to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] with the files and prototype of new droid circuitry, along with fellow [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] Jedi [[Ylenic It'kla]].<ref name="Elusion Illusion" />

====Infiltrating the Wheel====
[[File:MissiontotheWheel.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Secura fights Zenex on The Wheel]]
Less than a standard month later, Secura infiltrated [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]], posing as a down-on-her-luck mechanic named Jayzaa, in order to locate Quinlan Vos, who hadn't reported from his undercover mission since the Battle of Geonosis. Together, they secured a copy of the plans of the impending Confederacy attack on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. With the help of [[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]] and [[Tookarti]] they kept crime boss [[Zenex]] from stealing back the plans. After killing Zenex and his henchmen, Vos told Secura that he was going to set up spy networks for the Republic.<ref name="sacrifice">[[Republic 49|''Republic'' 49]]</ref>

====Battle of Kamino====
{{Quote|Perhaps you try too hard?''"<br />"''Maybe, I don't know. Things just get so...complicated sometimes! It's not like when I'm flying or fighting&mdash;or like when I was podracing. Everything seems so clear then.''"<br />"''Maybe things aren't always that simple.|Aayla Secura and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="The Battle of Kamino" />}}
Aayla Secura later visited Kamino alongside Master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and saved the [[Kamino cloning chamber|facilities]] from sabotage from within&mdash;a [[Kaminoan nano-virus]] meant to wipe out the clone troopers. During the last minutes of the battle against super battle droids (under the control of a double-crossing Kaminoan), Secura fell into the waters of Kamino and nearly drowned before being saved by Fisto. As an amphibian, the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] was able to absorb oxygen from the water and breathe it into Secura to help her breathe. When they were up on the surface again, they killed the double-crossing [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] using the virus by tricking her into injecting it into herself.<ref name="Tides of Terror">{{Tales|14|Tides of Terror}}</ref> Her collaboration with Fisto, a fellow Geonosis veteran, and his ability to read lekku&mdash;unusual for a non-Twi'lek&mdash;led to a close relationship between the two, one which pushed the limits of the Jedi Code at times.<ref name="Aayla Secura" />

[[File:Secura_talks_to_Anakin_on_Kamino.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Aayla Secura talks to Anakin prior to the Battle of Kamino.]]
After using the intelligence she and Quinlan Vos had collected, Secura was present at a meeting with various Jedi Generals hosted by Obi-Wan Kenobi prior to the battle on Kamino, there, [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] and Vos explained that the Confederacy needed to attack before they became aware of the Republic forces on Kamino, otherwise they would back out. Secura would be one of the many Jedi Generals that would use her starfighters to lead the flight to intercept the enemy fighters as the fighters for the clones were not ready yet. Minutes before the battle, Secura found Padawan Anakin Skywalker trying to fix a droid, claiming that he was meditating while doing it. The Jedi told Skywalker that maybe he was trying too hard to fix it and that things were not so simple. The Separatist forces soon arrived and every Jedi got ready to fly, with Secura engaging in the initial strike with her Jedi starfighter and successfully defending the cloning facilities.<ref name="The Battle of Kamino" />

====Battle of Hypori====
[[File:Aayla_and_Ki-Adi_vs._Grievous.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Aayla Secura fights Grievous with her Jedi allies on Hypori.]]
Later into the war, Secura ascended to the rank of Jedi Master. Subsequently,<ref name="CSWE" /> the Twi'lek Jedi, along with fellow Jedi Masters [[Daakman Barrek]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], [[K'Kruhk]] participated in the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Battle of Hypori]], where she was one of the Jedi who survived their first encounter with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Grievous gripped Secura and the dead [[Tarr Seirr]] with his feet and sent both flying into the ceiling.<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars 20">{{CW|20}}</ref> She suffered grave wounds in the attack, and only survived due to the intervention of a squad of [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]].<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars 21">{{CW|21}}</ref> It was after this mission that she was assigned to the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]], and later forged a close relationship with [[Bly/Legends|Commander Bly]].<ref name="gar">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> Later, Secura and the Jedi [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]] and [[Voolvif Monn]] were cornered in battle by [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droids]] and trapped by [[Bubble wort projector/Legends|bubble wort projectors]], only to be rescued and freed by Anakin Skywalker, now a Jedi Knight.<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars 22">{{CW|22}}</ref>

====Battle of Quell====
{{Quote|Are all Jedi this reckless?''"<br />"''Just the good ones.|Republic Admiral Yularen and Aayla Secura|<ref name="TCW: Jedi Crash">{{TCW|Jedi Crash}}</ref>}}
After [[Battle for the Galactic Republic information bunker|capturing]] an important Separatist [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Aayla Secura's ambush)|tactical droid]], Secura and Commander Bly were dispatched to lead an assault over the planet [[Quell/Legends|Quell]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Headgames">''[[The Clone Wars: Headgames]]''</ref>

As her ships were assaulted by [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|B2 Rocket droids]], Jedi Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], arrived and helped Bly and Secura evacuate the decimated Republic Cruiser.<ref name="TCW: Jedi Crash" />

The Jedi and the Clones destroyed most of the droids on her ship but were ambushed by a large number of Super Battle droids and were forced to flee toward Skywalker's ship. But then, an explosion started behind the pursuing droids. Skywalker noticed this early and Force pushed Secura, Tano, and some more clones into the ship's doorway and tried to use the Force to stop the explosion, but it didn't work and seriously injured him, but fortunately, Tano and Secura rescued him. Before the Jedi could dock aboard the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] to give Skywalker medical attention, fire from droid fighters knocked out one of the pilots, accidentally activating the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. Secura told Admiral [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] to take the ''Resolute'' up above, before they took the cruiser with them.<ref name="TCW: Jedi Crash" />

====Battle of Maridun====
{{Quote|Sometimes it takes courage to stick to one's beliefs, young Padawan.|Secura, to Ahsoka Tano|audio=ItTakesCourage_DoP.flac|<ref name="Defenders of Peace">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}}</ref>}}
[[File:Aayla_Maridun.jpg|thumb|250px|Aayla Secura on Maridun]]
After a treacherous trip through hyperspace, the Jedi and the few clones in their company crash landed on the planet [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. After they landed, Secura and Tano took Bly and the remaining troopers (except for Rex, who guarded Anakin during the night) to look for help. They found a drawing of a tree, so they looked for it, but some giant pods fell down. Secura noticed that other pods had been dragged away by. Secura guessed that whatever or whoever had dragged away the pods were sentient creatures and thought they might be able to help Anakin. The group followed the tracks and were attacked by a pair of mastiff phalones and only Bly, Tano and Secura came out alive. The next morning, they found a village of [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] who had settled on the planet, far away from the war. The village elder, [[Tee Watt Kaa/Legends|Tee Watt Kaa]] refused to aid them, fearing that destruction would break the peace they already had. However, at Tano's request, he did give them medical supplies and had his son, [[Wag Too/Legends|Wag Too]] help deliver them. But he requested that only one Jedi take the supplies and that Bly should follow. The Jedi agreed to this, Tano and Bly went to bring back Anakin, and the injured Jedi was healed.<ref name="TCW: Jedi Crash" /> During her time in the Lurmen village, Secura spoke with Kaa on the circumstances of the settlers' arrival on Maridun, learning that the Lurmen had abandoned the starship on which they had arrived to escape the native [[Amani/Legends|Amanin]]. The Jedi was surprised by the Lurmen's willingness to strand themselves on the foreign world, which the elder explained by way of his people's dedication to the principals of pacifism.<ref name="Neigh">''[[The Clone Wars: Neighbors]]''</ref>

Later, an army of droids, led by General [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]], landed on Maridun and upon meeting Tee Watt Kaa, claimed the planet for the Separatists. The Jedi and the clones decided to leave the village, or else the droids would have killed the Lurmen. They left but decided to steal a Separatist ship to get off of Maridun. They were followed by a spy droid, but they destroyed it before it could send news of their plans to the Separatists. The team climbed a tree and saw a Separatist fort and Durd testing a new weapon that destroyed life forms, but not machines. After the successful test, the Separatist army headed for the Lurmen village. The Jedi and the clones mounted a raid on the fort that night and stole a ship and two shield generators. They then headed back to the village. They offered their help, which Tee Watt Kaa turned down, but they then barricaded the village anyway. The Separatists reached the village and tried using their new weapon, but the shield generators stopped the effects of it. They then sent the droids out. Secura and the others obliterated the first wave, but the second group got past them and destroyed the shield generators. Secura and Tano took care of them while Skywalker destroyed the new weapon. After the battle, Wag Too thanked the Jedi for saving the village, and Kaa admitted that the Lurmen owe the Jedi their lives. Finally, three Jedi cruisers appeared and picked up Secura, Tano, Skywalker, Rex, and Bly.<ref name="Defenders of Peace" />

====Mission to Alzoc III====
[[File:SecuraUnduliVsVentress-TCWRH.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Aayla Secura and Luminara Unduli face off against Asajj Ventress.]]
Later Secura went with Jedi Master [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Commanders]] Bly and [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]], to [[Mission to Alzoc III|investigate]] the planet [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]], where Separatist activity had been reported by the Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. The Republic squad took several [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]] and headed for the coordinates of the location provided by Jabba. Along the way, the walkers were forced to scale a vertical cliff, and when a walker's path became blocked by two bulks of [[Water/Legends|ice]], Bly immediately ordered his men to blast them. Secura, however, ordered to hold, stating that the blast could lead to the collapse of the entire cliff, and proceeded to remove the obstacles in a more delicate way. Upon arriving at their destination, both the Jedi and the clone troopers witnessed a crash site of a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] and were stunned by the view of huge masses of ice and numerous starship parts floating freely in the air. Deciding to investigate the unusual phenomena, the clone troopers used their [[JT-12 jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] to reach what remained of the ship's hangar, while the Jedi followed them by using the Force to navigate through debris. Rendezvousing at the hangar, the group was attacked by a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid]], and it became apparent that the crash site attracted Separatist interest as well. Unduli and Secura quickly defeated the droid and ordered the clones to scout ahead and find the ship's data recorder, while they themselves engaged the battle droids and followed by an alternate route.<ref name="TCW:RH">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>

After reaching the remains of the ship's bridge, Gree began to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] the vessel's data recorder, while the Jedi and the clone troopers protected him from the attacking droids. After successfully neutralizing the battle droids, Gree was able to access the record of the ship's final moments. It became apparent that an individual had used a [[Telgorn dropship]] to board the Separatist [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] which was carrying two classified weapons, stole one of them, and then departed shortly before the frigate was hit by an explosion. The vessel had then crashed on the planet, where the weapon created a gravity anomaly. Soon, it was also revealed that the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] had already visited the crash site and set the remains of the frigate to [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct]]. Unduli and Secura ordered the clone troopers to safety and then briefly dueled Ventress. The two Jedi trapped the Dark Jedi under the bulk of ice before leaving the crash site and reporting to the Jedi High Council.<ref name="TCW:RH" />

[[File:SecuraYodaZilloBeast.png|thumb|240px|Aayla Secura and Yoda attempt to distract the Zillo beast.]]

====Distracting the Zillo Beast====
{{Quote|We aren't having much effect.''"<br />"''Time to leave, it is.|Aayla Secura and Yoda, on the Zillo Beast|<ref name="The Zillo Beast Strikes Back">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref>}}
When the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] broke out of its captivity on Coruscant, it stormed its way to the Senate building and captured the escape craft [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was using to usher himself, Anakin Skywalker, and Padmé Amidala to safety. Secura teamed with Yoda to leap onto the beast's back, attempting to distract it and allow the occupants of the escape craft enough time to scurry away from the beast's clutches. They were successful in their attempt, and followed the group to safety, shielding them from the cloud of gas from the toxin-bombs used to kill the Zillo beast.<ref name="The Zillo Beast Strikes Back" />

During a scouting mission to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], Secura came across a [[Battle of Florrum|confrontation]] between a Separatist frigate and fugitive bounty hunter [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama's]] [[Shahan Alama's Flarestar-class attack shuttle|''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle]] over the planet [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] and sent a [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] team led by Bly to investigate.<ref name="Hunting">[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part I)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part I)]]</ref>

====Hunting Attuma Duum====
{{Quote|Yes, tragic the events were&mdash;but a failure your mission was not. Destroyed was Duum's operation. And sense a change in ''you'' I do, Aayla Secura.''"<br />"''Yes...maybe. Perhaps I found something within myself that was ''missing'' before.|Yoda and Secura after her mission to Cavamina Minor|<ref name="Shon-Ju" />}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Secura was assigned an escort of elite clone troopers to arrest the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Attuma Duum]] on the moon [[Cavamina Minor]]. She was betrayed by Duum's operatives, and in the [[Skirmish in the Cavamina Minor cantina|ensuing struggle]] in the [[Cavamina Minor cantina|cantina]], all her clones were killed. She fled, and her [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B]] was shot down. She broadcast a distress signal on channel [[Delta-622-Echo]]. She was pursued on foot by [[Sabat (mercenary)|Sabat]], Duum's chief of security. The [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Shon-Ju]] intervened to rescue her, engaging Sabat and his [[Attuma Duum's security droid|security droid]]. Sabat activated his [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]], leaving Shon-Ju to assist a wounded Secura, who passed out from her wounds. Secura later woke up alone in [[Shon-Ju's castle]]. She explored the castle and found Shon-Ju watching over his students. The man told her his story, how he had trained as a Jedi but was rejected. Secura was ready to leave to return to her mission, but Shon-Ju told her to wait, because he wanted Duum shut down as well and agreed to accompany her.<ref name="Shon-Ju" />

The next morning, they stole two abandoned [[Unidentified bomber|bombers]] to infiltrate [[Attuma Duum's headquarters]]. Once aboard, Shon-Ju rashly took her lightsaber to trip the alarms. Secura used her Force powers to subude the guards, but Sabat took Shon-Ju hostage and force her to surrender. Once placed in suspension, Duum visited them but was called off to other matters. He had [[Battle of Cavamina Minor|lured]] two [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]], one of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and the other one from the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]. When Sabat was distracted, Shon-Ju told her he wanted to kill Duum to humiliate the Jedi, who had failed to capture the mercenary. Shon-Ju then used own Force powers to escape his bonds and attack Sabat, throwing the latter into a turbine and killing him. Shon-Ju left Secura in her bonds for the moment, telling her that her destiny was in her hands, but she wouldn't stop him from finishing what he had come for. Shon-Ju then went to confront Duum, who revealed his [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] body. As flames from the damaged base spread near her, Secura accessed the Force to escape. She arrived in time to intervene, preventing Shon-Ju from finishing a damaged Duum. Shon-Ju started attacking her instead, allowing Duum to escape. As the two traded blows, Secura had a flashback to what Yoda had once told her. Shon-Ju picked her up by her lekku, sayihng he would end it for her quickly, but she just laughed in response, saying being a Jedi was accepting one's place. She then used the Force to grab her lightsaber and cut off Shon-Ju's hands. Shon-Ju said the Jedi kept ''taking'' from him, and ran off in tears into the flames.<ref name="Shon-Ju" />

With the base in its death throes, Secura stole another bomber to return to Coruscant. There she met Grand Master Yoda to discuss the results of her mission. Yoda consoled her, telling her Duum's operation was destroyed, and that he sensed a change in her. She replied that she found something inside of her which had been missing. She had doubts though, whether the change was for the better, as Duum could still be alive. Unbeknownst to her, both Duum and Shon-Ju had indeed survived, the latter accepting a set of prosthetics.<ref name="Shon-Ju" />

====Mission to Devaron====
Later in the war, Secura [[Mission to Devaron|investigated Separatist raids]] on Republic supply lines along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] as part of a Jedi task force of masters Tholme, [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]], Kit Fisto, and [[The Dark Woman|An'ya Kuro]]. During the mission, Tholme delivered to Secura [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] message from Vos in which he claimed to have defected to the Confederacy,<ref name="Aayla Secura" /> in reality an undercover operation orchestrated by his former master.<ref name="Rep65">[[Republic 65|''Republic'' 65]]</ref>

When the headquarters of the raiders were pinpointed to the planet [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]], Secura went undercover as "Tuulaa Doneeta," the spoiled daughter of a Twi'lek shipping baron. This way, she managed to infiltrate Senator [[Vien'sai'Malloc]]'s apartments as her guest, with Masters Tholme ("Miles Croft"), and Kuro ("Saba") as her servants. The Senator was the one who backed the raiders, hoping to play both sides in the war. She had hired bounty hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], an ex-Jedi, to make sure nobody learned of her plans.<ref name="Aayla Secura" />

[[File:Secura_and_Sing.jpg|thumb|220px|Aayla Secura dueling Aurra Sing on Devaron.]]
The Jedi on Devaron were Sing's next targets, and after caving in her former Master and Tholme, she ambushed Secura. The Twi'lek survived and attacked Aurra. The two fought, and Secura was able to win by hitting the bounty hunter where it hurt: her feelings of abandonment. Aurra reacted by unleashing her rage, but thus became disoriented, and Secura cut off the antenna implant&mdash;installed by the hunter's Anzati mentors&mdash;that allowed Sing to feed off the fear of her prey. As Sing was enveloped in anger, Secura was at peace, and turned the former Padawan over to local authorities. She eventually ended up on the penal colony of [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]]. Then, Secura rescued Tholme and Kuro and provided intelligence she had gathered about the raider headquarters to Fisto and Saa and the raiders were dissolved in a battle between them and Republic forces.<ref name="Aayla Secura" />

====Betrayal on Honoghr====
On [[New Holstice/Legends|New Holstice]], Secura was apprised by Bly of a [[Battle of New Holstice/Legends|costly victory]] over [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces and joined Tholme in a Republic hospital. Her one-time master revealed to Secura that Quinlan Vos had not really betrayed the Jedi Order but was a double agent infiltrating the Separatists to spy on Dooku, although he feared that Vos had fallen to the dark side.<ref name="Rep65" />

[[File:BattleHonoghr.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Secura during the Battle of Honoghr]]
She was then sent to the head of a squad of clones and seconded by the [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] Bly on [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]] to recover the [[Scientific Instrument Package]] (SIP) containing all data on a [[Trihexalophine1138|deadly gas]] developed by the Separatists and fell into the hands of [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] warriors. She had to battle against the fierce natives when unexpected help came: her former master Quinlan Vos. But when they had recovered the SIP, Quinlan turned against Aayla to bring her to Dooku. Aayla was again forced to fight Vos but was defeated. Bly intervened to save her life; shooting Vos and causing him to flee.<ref name="arm">[[Republic 68|''Republic'' 68]]</ref>

Secura and Ki-Adi-Mundi were dispatched on a [[Mission on Hitaka|top secret mission]] on the planet [[Hitaka]] for the Supreme Chancellor&mdash;in reality, a ruse to distract the Jedi from operations on the world by the Separatists,<ref name="CoC">{{CWACite|10|Chain of Command (comic story)}}</ref> clandestinely led by Palpatine in his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] identity of Darth Sidious.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" /> Secura and Mundi conducted diversionary action of their own, deceiving Jedi Knight [[Anise I'Zak]] into conducting a decoy mission while they completed their objective.<ref name="CoC" />

====Mission to Endor====
{{Quote|Do you have ''any'' Jedi skills whatsoever?|A sarcastic battle droid, to Aayla Secura|<ref name="What Goes Up">{{CWACite|5|What Goes Up... (comic story)}}</ref>}}
[[File:IHateJedi-CW5.jpg|thumb|170px|Secura, with the battle droid, begin their duty to kill the Beast in the Mouth of the Mountain.]]
Shortly after, Master Secura and Commander Bly investigated a deserted Separatist outpost in the Endor system. After discovering the base to be empty, (and finding remains of countless clone troopers and battle droids) Secura went out scouting in the forest on her own, during which she was spied upon by a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid (Endor)|lone battle droid]]. When it attempted to shoot her, she severed its appendages with her lightsaber. While interrogating the droid, Secura was caught unaware by the native Ewok people hiding in a tree and was shot with a tranquilizer dart.<ref name="What Goes Up" />
Secura awoke within an Ewok treehouse, and while using the battle droid as a translator, she learnt that the natives believed that she was a forest spirit. As a spirit, the Ewoks said that it was her duty to vanquish the [[Beast in the Mouth of the Mountain]] that terrorized them. Secura, taking the opinionated battle droid along with her, complied to their wishes. While climbing the very tall mountain to the Beast's lair, Secura argued with the droid over her sympathy for her clone troopers and became increasingly annoyed with it as their journey progressed up the huge mountain peak.

[[File:Mission_to_Endor.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Secura attacking the Beast in the Mouth of the Mountain]]
Upon reaching the cave of the Beast in the Mouth of the Mountain, the Jedi Master tripped on a large pile of bones at the mouth of the cave, alerting the Beast to their presence in its lair. The huge Beast quickly impaled the unarmed battle droid with its sharp claws, killing it, but this fortunately left the Twi'lek Jedi Master free to use the Force on the collapsing parts of the ceiling of the cave, forcing them down upon the monster, killing it instantly. Having fulfilled her duty as the Ewok's spirit, Secura then returned back to her Republic gunships at their rendezvous point, where Bly and her clone troopers were patiently waiting for her. Dismissing her commander's worries about where she had been, the pair, along with their squadron of clone troopers, headed on their next mission. The Ewoks would remember Secura's brave deeds forever, by immortalizing her in a large painting depicting her defeat of the huge Beast, which they would respect for many years to come.<ref name="What Goes Up" />

====Siege of Saleucami====
Secura accompanied Tholme to the planet [[Anzat/Legends|Anzat]] in order to investigate the renegade Jedi [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]], Dooku's right hand. She found Bulq's ship, fought against a Morgukai warrior and stole the logbooks. The logbooks revealed separatist activity on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].<ref name="Republic 72">[[Republic 72|''Republic'' 72]]</ref>

Then, the Council assigned her on a mission to [[Trigalis/Legends|Trigalis]].<ref name="Republic 72" /> There, she met Obi-Wan Kenobi, obsessed with [[Mission to Trigalis|stalking]] Asajj Ventress, and offered him [[Aayla Secura's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|her Jedi starfighter]].<ref name="Obsession 1">[[Obsession 1|''Obsession'' 1]]</ref> She then received a transmission from Tholme, telling her that the Separatists had created an army of Bok's clones on Saleucami, the Morgukai warrior she had defeated years ago, specially trained by Anzati to kill Jedi.<ref name="Republic 73">[[Republic 73|''Republic'' 73]]</ref>

[[File:Siege_of_Saleucami.jpg|thumb|220px|Secura and Bly during the Siege of Saleucami]]
The Republic therefore sent an army to lay [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|siege to Saleucami]], supported by many Jedi including Quinlan Vos, apparently repentant but still playing a double game. Piloting a Jedi starfighter with the Republic's [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], Secura provided air support to the ground forces and destroyed Separatist [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] exposed by her allies' sabotage of their [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], forcing the enemy to retreat.<ref name="Republic 74" />

Secura and Vos fought side by side against Morgukai clones,<ref name="Republic 75">[[Republic 75|''Republic'' 75]]</ref> destroyed the [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] that prevented the Republic forces from bombarding the planet and destroyed the cloning facilities.<ref name="Republic 76">[[Republic 76|''Republic'' 76]]</ref> Secura then had to face Bok again and killed him, while Vos faced Sora Bulq in a duel, sliding more towards the dark side of the Force. Secura and Tholme went into meditation and snatched Quinlan from the darkness, allowing him to defeat his opponent.<ref name="Republic 77">[[Republic 77|''Republic'' 77]]</ref>

===Death===
{{Quote|When her death came, I hoped it was quick. She earned that much.|A 501st clone trooper|<ref name="battlefront II" />}}
[[File:BlyShootsAayla.png|thumb|left|250px|Aayla Secura being gunned down by her troops during the execution of Order 66 on Felucia.]]
Following the siege of Saleucami, Secura and her troops were [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|sent]] to Felucia to help Jedi Knight [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] uncover a plot to poison Felucia's water supply.<ref name="ROF">''[[Reversal of Fortune]]''</ref> There, Secura had also gained the respect of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] in the time they served with her when she saved them from a number of deadly acklays and helped destroy an auto-turret system.<ref name="battlefront II" /> After freeing Offee and her new Padawan [[Zonder/Legends|Zonder]], Secura and the Padawans [[Ekria/Legends|Ekria]] and [[Drake Lo'gaan/Legends|Drake Lo'gaan]] were able to discover that [[Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] had arranged the poisoning of Felucia's water supply.<ref name="ROF" />

While Offee took a squad to [[Har Gau/Legends|Har Gau]], Secura and Commander Bly went to [[Niango/Legends|Niango]].<ref name="ROF" /> While preparing to engage an oncoming onslaught of droids, Secura glanced to the skies as a [[Felucia bird/Legends|Felucian bird]] flew overhead. Standing behind her friend and commanding officer, the ever-loyal Commander Bly received word from the Supreme Chancellor ordering him to carry out [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which denounced Secura and her fellow Jedi as traitors to the Republic. Distracted by the bird, the Twi'lek could not even ignite her lightsaber before she was struck by blasterfire from behind; as she crumpled to the ground beneath a large fungal growth, her troops continued to fire at her body repeatedly. Soon after, the AT-TE walker that was closest to her fired at Barriss Offee, making her the next victim of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" /> Both died on 16:5:23 GrS.

While on the run from his own clone forces, Quinlan Vos felt a void in his sense of Secura,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy 2">[[Republic 82|''Republic'' 82]]</ref> and concluded that she had been killed.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy 3" /> Immediately after the Twi'lek's death, Secura's friend Jedi Master Darrus Jeht felt her demise through the Force and experienced a vision of her being killed by the clone troopers, which greatly upset him.<ref name="One Minute to Midnight" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|They believe you are a forest spirit&hellip;|[[Unidentified B1 battle droid (Endor)|Anonymous B1 battle droid]]|<ref name="What Goes Up" />}}
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] emerged, [[Casualty Report: Order 66|official records]] compiled by [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] stated that Aayla Secura and Barriss Offee were both executed because they were plotting to poison Felucia's water supply, although it was really the Separatists.<ref name="Order 66">{{InsiderCite|87|Order 66: Destroy All Jedi}}</ref> When the purge of the Jedi Order was enacted, a member of the 501st reflected on his time on Felucia with Secura and, though he believed the Jedi to be traitors to the Republic, hoped that she had been granted a quick death as he believed that "she had earned that much".

However, despite the attempts of the Empire, Aayla Secura was remembered by the peoples of the worlds she aided, in some cases merging with pre-existing goddess myths or historical figures. As late as [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], a professor by the name of [[Movac Arisster]] believed that he had seen a vision of Secura telling him to kill a Jedi, though this had in fact been a projection by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Lumiya]]. By that time, there were still fictitious accounts of her life being written.<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Does it concern you that you have doubts?"<br />"No, I think it is good. I trust in my skills and training, but without doubts, without realizing that things could spin out of control, I would become arrogant, a failing that could lead to the dark side."<br />"Very good, Aayla Secura. Now you know why you are worthy of being entrusted with so important a mission.|Jedi Knights Ylenic It'kla and Aayla Secura|<ref name="Elusion Illusion" />}}
[[File:Aayla_bellybutton.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Although her clothing was practical, Secura was not devoid of ornamentation as this ornate navel jewelry illustrates.]]
Aayla Secura was an empathetic and highly intelligent Jedi but was also impulsive and somewhat mischievous.<ref name="DB" /> Becoming very confident, though not arrogant, in her abilities, she was a good leader and a skilled tactician; her quick thinking earned her the respect of many clone troopers during the Clone Wars. Her given name, Aayla, was common for female Twi'leks and it meant 'smoke' or 'mist' in [[Twi'leki/Legends|Ryl]].<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

In the aftermath of the events on Kiffex, she felt something was missing inside of her. Master Yoda consoled her and told her to believe that the Force gave her strength. Events on Cavamina Minor years later forced a change inside of her, and she said she felt something had been found.<ref name="Shon-Ju" />

[[File:Force_Bond.jpg|thumb|Force-sensitives Aayla Secura and Quinlan Vos form an immediate Force bond.]]
Secura had a brief romantic relationship with Kit Fisto, but she was dedicated to the Jedi Order and decided the Order was more important than her relationship with Fisto, though they would still nurse feelings for each other. From childhood, Aayla formed an intimate Force bond with her savior, the stripling Padawan Quinlan Vos, years before he turned to the dark side; she once said that he had been like a father to her.<ref name="TCW: Jedi Crash" /> Like her relationship with Fisto, however, she eventually learned to let go of her attachment to her master, and she later taught Ahsoka Tano, Skywalker's padawan, to do the same.<ref name="TCW: Jedi Crash" /> She did not let anger or violent feelings control her.<ref name=":0" /> She also had a close friendship with Commander Bly, but like most clones Bly obeyed Order 66, betrayed her trust, and killed her.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />

Secura's attire was practical, albeit somewhat revealing, and allowed her to both move freely and show her Jedi affiliations. She also wore ornate jewelry on her navel.<ref name="Visions">''[[Star Wars Art: Visions]]''</ref> Secura liked to do a form of moving meditation as she thought better that way.<ref name="The Battle of Kamino" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|The Force has made us strong.|Aayla Secura|<ref name="battlefront II" />}}
Aayla Secura was trained as a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]],<ref name="wotc">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20020530cdarkblue&c=rpg|text=Dark Blue}}</ref> a particularly martial class of Jedi,<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> becoming an impressively skilled fighter. She quickly mastered [[Form IV/Legends|Ataru]],<ref name="CWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> the fourth form of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], in the fifth,<ref name="Jedi Path" /> [[Form V/Legends|Djem So]], had some ability,<ref name="ROTSVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and was a practitioner of dual-lightsaber combat.<ref name="battlefront II" /> Secura's lightsaber skills allowed her to survive the battle of Geonosis,<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> hold her own against General Grievous, (albeit with help from several other Jedi)<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars 20" /> and overpower the skilled bounty hunter Aurra Sing in a duel.<ref name="Aayla Secura" /> She had also grown adept in unarmed fighting, especially while sparring with Commander Bly.<ref name="ROF" /> In combat she was known to use the [[Nexu/Legends|Nexu]] stance evasive roll.<ref name="TCW H2H" /> On some occasions, she would wield her green-bladed lightsaber in tandem with her blue blade, in order to apply her [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]] skills in combat.<ref name="battlefront II" /> Early in the Clone Wars, she was almost killed by a Mastiff phalone attack and could not save most of her men.<ref name="TCW: Jedi Crash" /> She was good at deflecting shots fired from point blank range and evading darts.<ref name="sacrifice" /><ref name="arm" /> She was tough enough to get back up after being tossed around by Vos.<ref name="arm" />  She was always better at flying machines than Vos.<ref name="wotc" /> 

In addition to her combat skills, Secura was very skilled in stealth and infiltration which she learned from Quinlan Vos and Tholme, who were considered less intuitive with the Force that she was.<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 44" /> Secura also had some skill with [[Force cloak]], using it to prevent a swarm of [[Quarra]] beasts from noticing as she walked among them, which was a hard to learn ability that some masters couldn't complete.<ref name="Aayla Secura" /> The Jedi could [[Force stealth|hide her Force presence]], as she did to prevent Sora Bulq from noticing any more than a passing flicker of her power when she was spying on some traitors to the Republic. She used [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force push and Force pull]] to great effect,<ref name="Shon-Ju" /> such as when she telekinetically pressed a lever and pulled her saber to her hand,<ref name="TCW: Jedi Crash" /> when she threw debris at Sing and Force pushed the assassin,<ref name="Aayla Secura" /> knocked Noghri into a wall,<ref name="arm" /> and slew Bok by pushing him against a laser gate, after using the [[Force jump/Legends|Force to leap]] around one of his blows and outmaneuver him.<ref name="Republic 77" /> Previously, she had also used the technique of saber throw against other [[Morgukai]] warriors.<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 44" /> She also could [[Force deflection/Legends|deflect]] blaster bolts with the Force.<ref name="arm" /> Once, she raised a [[Force barrier/Legends|barrier]] to protect herself when a ship she was on was destroyed,<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 43" /> and later held back deadly gas.<ref name="The Zillo Beast Strikes Back" /> Though she was defeated, she was able to survive the blast of a Death Watch rocket.<ref name="Darth Maul—Son of Dathomir 3">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 3|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 3]]</ref> In addition to her power to move objects, she could [[Enhance Attribute|augment her body’s abilities]].<ref name="wotc" /> Secura could fall a great distance without being hurt, if she had time to ready herself for the leap,<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 44" /> and on Maridun, she used the Force to jump up a massive tree and spring from side to side up a wall.<ref name="Defenders of Peace" /> Her [[Force sense/Legends|Force senses]] were such that she could find other Jedi,<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 43" /><ref name="Star Wars (1998) 34" /> [[Life Sense|detect the health]] of her allies,<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 45" /> [[Force empathy/Legends|know Ahsoka's feelings and fears]],<ref name="TCW: Jedi Crash" /> and feel the dark side in others and sometimes feel their intent to betray her,<ref name="arm" /> and she was a skilled pilot, more so than her master Quinlan Vos<ref name="wotc" /> She was also known to use her beauty and Force powers to seduce people into giving information.<ref name="Republic 72" /> She could use the Force to calm others,<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 42" /> [[Mind trick/Legends|make them follow her orders]],<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 43" /> or fall asleep.<ref name="Aayla Secura" /> The Jedi had a slight measure of skill at [[Force healing/Legends|Force healing]].<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 45" /> Aayla Secura also dabbled in the dark side, such as gaining a proficiency in Force choke,<ref name="wotc" /> was able to use [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].<ref name=":0">[[Star Wars (Hasbro toy line)|''Star Wars'' Hasbro toy line]]</ref>

==Equipment==
[[File:AaylaSecurasLightsaber-JediCrash.png|thumb|left|150px|Aayla Secura's lightsaber]]
{{Quote|This is ''yours'', Aayla. Your ''lightsaber''. Take it.|Quinlan Vos|<ref name="SW22" />}}
As Quinlan Vos' Padawan, she used a red-bladed lightsaber,<ref name="SW22" /> and adopted a blue-bladed [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] during her retraining under Master Tholme.<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 43" /> By the time of the Clone Wars, Secura possessed two sabers of her own construction,<ref name="CWCG" /> and wielded either a blue and green blade together,<ref name="battlefront II" /> or a single blue lightsaber,<ref name="Attack of the Clones" /> that she primary used during [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] campaigns, until her [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], where she was betrayed by the troops under her command and gunned down before she could defend herself.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />

When Secura was rescued from slavery, she wore a simple light brown dress with darker head and foot wraps of the same hue.<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 42" /> Early in her apprenticeship to Vos, she wore traditional, cream-colored [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] joined with a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]], a sleeveless brown cloak, and a headband dotted with gold-colored ornaments.<ref name="Heart of Fire" /> By the time of her mission to Ryloth, she had taken to wearing a mesh bodysuit beneath a sleeved cloak,<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 20">[[Star Wars (1998) 20|''Star Wars'' (1998) 20]]</ref> and wore similar&mdash;albeit less covering&mdash;garb in her amnesiac enslavement by Pol Secura.<ref name="SW22" /> In her time on Kiffex, Secura wore<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 32" /> a Twi'lek-style Jedi uniform:<ref name="CWCG" /> brown [[combat boots]], trousers, and unadorned head-and-lekku-wraps, with a [[Rycrit/Legends|rycrit]] hide belt<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and one-sleeved vest. Secura preferred this fitted clothing to the traditional, flowing Jedi robes, which she found restrictive in combat.<ref name="CWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Though Secura again wore the mesh suit while returning to Coruscant with Tholme,<ref name="SW36" /> she sported the Twi'lek Jedi robes as his Padawan,<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 43" /> as she would continue to do until her death.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" /> Secura also wore various disguises when operating under an assumed identity: she wore a [[Huttese slave-girl costume]] as a servant to Ro Fenn,<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 42" /> black pants and top with shoulder pads and goggles as the mechanic Jaayza<ref name="sacrifice" /> (or Jayzaa),<ref name="Republic 72" /> and white-and-purple gowns as trade heiress Tuulaa Doneeta.<ref name="Aayla Secura" />

Under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Red Two/Legends|Red Two]],<ref name="CSWERed2">{{CSWECite|III|88|Red Two (1)}}</ref> Secura flew a Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor with Jedi Master [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi's]] [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red Squadron]] in the battle for Kamino of the Clone Wars.<ref name="The Battle of Kamino" /> By the time of her covert mission to Trigalis, she possessed a blue-hulled [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]], which she lent to Obi-Wan Kenobi,<ref name="Obsession 1" /> and later flew a red-brown ''Actis''-class [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptor]] with Blue Squadron during the siege of Saleucami.<ref name="Republic 74" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I was thinking of killing her off early, just to up Quin's angst quotient, but Jan's daughter Sian asked us not to. I'm glad she did!|John Ostrander, on Aayla Secura's character development|<ref name="JCFDeath">{{JCFCite|url=posts/21677884|board=Authors and Artists|thread=The Official John Ostrander Discussion Thread|user=jfostrander|date=2005-09-23|time=7:52 am|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160810072346/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-john-ostrander-discussion-thread.5863919/page-78|quote=I was thinking of killing her off early, just to up Quin's angst quotient, but Jan's daughter Sian asked us not to. I'm glad she did!}}</ref>}}
[[File:SWPicsMissFisto.jpg|thumb|Early, unused concept art by [[Dermot Power]], of a fish-like Jedi that would evolve into Kit Fisto.]]
Aayla Secura was originally created for the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] by artist [[Jan Duursema]] and writer [[John Ostrander]]. In early concept art for the character, she was a fish-like creature rather than a Twi'lek.<ref name="fish girl">{{Facebook|username=jan.duursema.7|url=photo.php?fbid=10151868261798993&set=a.10150421871483993.411075.703558992&type=1&relevant_count=1&ref=nf|name=[[Jan Duursema]]|date=2013-08-19|quote=Original concept art for Quinlan Vos and Aayla Secura--yes, Aayla was almost a little fish girl...|archivefile=File:JanDuursema-AaylaSecura-August-19-2013.png}}</ref> After seeing a piece of cover art of the final character, [[George Lucas]] decided to place her in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="DB" />

Aayla Secura was portrayed by [[Amy Allen]] in ''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' and [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="DB" /> and was voiced by [[Jennifer Hale]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' TV series. Series director [[Dave Filoni]] had Hale perform the role with a French accent in homage to the French resistance fighters of World War II.<ref name="Hale">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20090123b.html|text=Jennifer Hale: Twi'lek Time}}</ref>

[[File:SW1998-33-Textless.jpg|thumb|150px|The painting by [[Jon Foster]] that secured Secura's place in the [[Star Wars#Films|''Star Wars'' saga]]]]
Her surname came from Nat Secura, originally introduced in the short story ''[[Of the Day's Annoyances: Bib Fortuna's Tale]]'' from ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]''. The two eventually appeared together in [[Star Wars: Rite of Passage|''Rite of Passage'']]. Writer John Ostrander originally wanted to kill Secura in ''Twilight'', but was convinced by Jan Duursema's daughter Sian to let her live.<ref name="JCFDeath" />

Secura is depicted in the game ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' as having two lightsabers&mdash;a green one and a blue one (although she has blue and purple sabers in the cutscenes and the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]] version)&mdash;but uses a single blue saber in all [[Canon#Canon in the Holocron continuity database|G- and T-canon]] appearances. In ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' Secura makes appearance in the [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] and PlayStation Portable-exclusive duel mode.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> and is voiced by [[Kari Wahlgren]]. In the video game [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], all concept art can be unlocked by entering AAYLASECURA as a cheat code.<ref name="EpIII VG">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]]</ref>

While the [[Dark Horse Comics]] story "[[What Goes Up... (comic story)|What Goes Up...]]," from [[2006]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 5]]'', established that Secura traveled from Endor to take part in the Battle of Felucia,<ref name="What Goes Up" /> the [[Dark Times 6|sixth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times]]'' series, published in the [[2007|following year]], states that she was deployed to Felucia from Saleucami,<ref name="DT6">[[Dark Times 6|''Dark Times'' 6]]</ref> making the exact sequence of events unclear.
